scope: One installation with its environments on a clean machine, not a real server. An upgrade to a version with a newer PostgREST (v14.15 to v14.16) through lab/upgrade.py and a restart. An upgrade to a version whose PostgREST never answers, which the supervisor moved back by itself. An upgrade to a version that migrates the control catalog and then stops, which the supervisor moved back by itself, restoring the catalog snapshot. Application traffic answered 503 while a version waited for its health checks. An upgrade to a version that starts but never passes its health checks, which the supervisor moved back by itself once the deadline passed. Release tags from a local repository: one signed by the listed key accepted, an unsigned one and one signed by an unlisted key refused, with nothing moved. Data is compared by row counts, and the control catalog by its schema version and a digest of its organizations, projects, environments and memberships, not every table.
